summary: Anavex Life Sciences Corp. filed an 8-K solely to disclose submission of a Nasdaq compliance plan after missing its 10-Q deadline. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist demand, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting trigger, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC action. It is a routine regulatory update with no special-situation event.
